#why: Luxor Governorate takes Esna and Armant from Qena (EGY.25_1): since 7 December 2009 Luxor includes them (PCGN Egypt factfile, web:2da20e2d8dcbc0a1, note 21; wiki:en:479606@1368983988, 2,409.68 km2). GADM, COD-AB and the World Bank draw the pre-2009 city; Overture's EG-LX (2026-08-19.0) alone holds Luxor, Armant, Esna, Qurna, Bayadiya and Tod and leaves out Qena and Qus, so its EG-LX is the clip. Only this line is taken from Overture: compared with the other datasets, its Delta lines are wrong in ten places. Ruled 2026-10-20 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj).

Zagreb County (HRV.21_1) takes back its southern belt with Velika Gorica from Grad Zagreb (HRV.4_1): GADM's Grad Zagreb is 1,264 km2 where the city is 641.2 km2 (wiki:en:55906@1376313555), leaving Zagreb County in two halves. geoBoundaries, Overture and the World Bank agree on all 21 Croatian units, so Overture's Zagreb County (HR-01) is the clip. Guard point: Velika Gorica, GeoNames 3188244 (HR.20 Zagreb County), must lie in GADM's Grad Zagreb before the move and in Zagreb County after it; once GADM files it in Zagreb County, the row is withdrawn. Checked 2026-11-18 by position; ruled 2026-11-18 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj).

The Capital Governorate (KWT.4_1) takes Failaka, Miskan, Awhah and Umm an Naml islands and the Sulaibikhat and Doha districts from GADM's Al Jahrah (KWT.3_1): English Wikipedia's district table puts them in the Capital Governorate (wiki:en:930688@1374263643), and geoBoundaries, Overture and the World Bank file them in KW-KU, so Overture's KW-KU is the clip. Guard points: Jazirat Faylaka, GeoNames 285638 (KW.02 Al Asimah), and Jazirat Miskan, GeoNames 285553, must lie in GADM's Al Jahrah before the move and in the Capital Governorate after it; once GADM files them there, the row is withdrawn. Checked 2026-11-18 by position; ruled 2026-11-18 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj).

The Halaib Triangle goes to Red Sea Governorate (EGY.2_1): Egypt holds and administers it, Sudan claims it (disputed_areas.tsv B93, wiki:en:1256880@1377784992), and Natural Earth's Egypt outline holds it, but GADM's Red Sea stops at the 1902 administrative line and GADM files the triangle under Sudan's Red Sea state, so Egypt's subdivision cards drew 18,170 km2 of Egypt's land as sea. The ground is Natural Earth's disputed feature B93 (ne_10m_admin_0_disputed_areas) within Egypt's outline. Guard point: Hala'ib town, GeoNames 374290; once GADM draws the triangle in an Egyptian unit, the row is withdrawn. Sudan's cards are unchanged and draw it as the claim. Ruled 2026-11-12 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj): 'Halaib to EG-BA'.

GADM's Harbour Island (BHS.14_1) polygon is the cays of Spanish Wells - St. George's Cay with Spanish Wells town, Russell Island and an islet 1.5 km north - so the whole row goes to Spanish Wells (BHS.31_1), which in GADM holds only Royal Island and the cays west of it. The point is Spanish Wells, English Wikipedia {{coord|25|32|45|N|76|45|40|W}} (wiki:en:4124238@1376884299: 'a medium-sized town on the island of St. George's Cay'), inside GADM's BHS.14_1. Overture 2026-08-19.0's BS-SW covers BHS.14_1 and BHS.31_1 together. geoBoundaries, Natural Earth's admin 1 and the World Bank's admin 1 share the defect. Checked 2026-10-18.

Harbour Island itself (2.97 km2) is a part of GADM's North Eleuthera (BHS.24_1) and goes to the Harbour Island row (BHS.14_1), applied after that row is emptied of Spanish Wells' cays. The point is Harbour Island, English Wikipedia {{coord|25|30|N|76|38|W}} (wiki:en:2669092@1376080991), inside that part; Overture 2026-08-19.0's BS-HI covers it whole and no other GADM part. Man Island and Jacobs Island, which Overture leaves in North Eleuthera, stay there. Checked 2026-10-18.

GADM's Îles Australes (PYF.1_1, 96 parts, east to 134.45 W) holds 68 parts, 215 km2, that are the Gambier Islands and the south-east Tuamotus (Mangareva, Moruroa, Fangataufa, the Actéon group, Tematangi, Hereheretue), which belong to Tuamotu-Gambier (PYF.5_1): Overture's and Natural Earth's units agree part by part, and every GeoNames point in them is PF.03 Tuamotu-Gambier (or PF.00), none PF.05. Moved points: Rikitea, Mangareva (GeoNames 4030556), Otetou, Hereheretue (13561123), Temoe (4030521); kept points: Mataura, Tubuai (4034228), Ahurei, Rapa (4034723), Rairua, Raivavae (4033742). Ruled 2026-11-18 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj).

GADM's Midway Islands (UMI.6_1) also hold Kure, Pearl and Hermes, Lisianski, Laysan and French Frigate Shoals, the State of Hawaii's Northwestern Hawaiian Islands (GeoNames US.HI; Midway is among 'the only three islands in the Hawaiian Islands not part of the state of Hawaii', wiki:en:19250@1370264178). Overture's and Natural Earth's UM-71 are Midway Atoll alone, so only parts within 30 km of Midway Atoll (GeoNames 5854942) are kept. Dropped points: Lisianski Island (GeoNames 5850291) and Laysan Island (GeoNames 5850186). Checked 2026-11-18; ruled 2026-11-18 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj).
